rule CobaltStrike_Beacon_Config {
    meta:
        description = "Detects embedded configuration in Cobalt Strike Beacon payloads"
        author = "SOC Team"
        malpedia_reference = "https://malpedia.caad.fkie.fraunhofer.de/details/win.cobalt_strike_beacon"
        malpedia_version = "20241115"
        malpedia_license = "Creative Commons CC BY-NC-SA 4.0"
        malpedia_sharing = "TLP:WHITE"
    strings:
        $a = { 2E 63 6F 6D 00 } // ".com" string
        $b = "Mozilla/5.0 (Windows NT" wide ascii
        $c = "Accept: */*" wide ascii
        $d = "Host:" wide ascii
        $e = { 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 } // 16 nulls common in config
    condition:
        uint16(0) == 0x5A4D and // MZ header
        $a and $b and $c and $d and $e
}
